info.title: google_ads (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: Google Ads API (REST). Requires Authorization: Bearer {token}, developer-token header, and optionally login-customer-id for manager accounts. customerId is the Google Ads customer ID (digits only, no dashes). Most read operations use GAQL (Google Ads Query Language) via the googleAds:search endpoint.

post.summary: Run a GAQL (Google Ads Query Language) query against the account. This environment provides campaign and user-list rows,
post.description: Run a GAQL (Google Ads Query Language) query against the account. This environment provides campaign and user-list rows, including their seeded metric fields. Example queries: 'SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign.status, campaign.advertising_channel_type FROM campaign', 'SELECT user_list.id, user_list.name, user_list.description FROM user_list'.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description: Google Ads customer ID â€” digits only, no dashes.

requestBody.description: Body: {query: string (required, GAQL query), pageToken?: string}. Google Ads API v19 uses fixed pages of up to 10,000 rows and rejects pageSize.

get.summary: Fetch a single campaign using its resource name or numeric ID.
get.description: Fetch a single campaign using its resource name or numeric ID.

parameters.name: campaignId
parameters.description: Numeric ID of the campaign to retrieve.

200.description: {resourceName, id, name, status, advertisingChannelType, startDate, endDate, campaignBudget}

post.summary: Apply a batch of create, update, or remove operations across one or more campaigns in a single call.
post.description: Apply a batch of create, update, or remove operations across one or more campaigns in a single call.

requestBody.description: Body: {operations: [{create?: Campaign, update?: Campaign, remove?: string (resource name), updateMask?: string}], partialFailure?: boolean, validateOnly?: boolean}

post.description: Delete a member (identified by email) from a Google Ads customer match user list. Use this to exclude a contact from a remarketing audience.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description: Google Ads customer ID â€” digits only, no dashes.

requestBody.description: Body: {email: string (required â€” the email address to remove from the list)}

post.description: Instantiate an offline user data job for adding or removing members in a customer match list. After creating the job, queue operations, then execute the job.

post.description: Enqueue user identifiers to be added or removed as part of an offline user data job.

post.description: Trigger execution of an offline user data job to apply its queued operations. This is an asynchronous long-running operation.

parameters.name: offlineUserDataJobId
parameters.description: Identifier of the offline user data job to execute.

post.summary: Submit offline click conversion events to Google Ads, matched by gclid (Google click ID). Used to attribute sales or sig
post.description: Submit offline click conversion events to Google Ads, matched by gclid (Google click ID). Used to attribute sales or sign-ups that originated from an ad click but were completed outside the browser.

requestBody.description: Body: {conversions: [{gclid: string, conversionAction: string (resource name), conversionDateTime: string, conversionValue?: number, currencyCode?: string}], partialFailure?: boolean, validateOnly?: boolean}

status.description: Current serving state of the campaign.

campaign_budget.description: Resource path pointing to the budget associated with this campaign.

end_date.description: Date the campaign stops running (YYYY-MM-DD), if set.

advertising_channel_type.description: Channel type for this campaign: SEARCH, DISPLAY, VIDEO, SHOPPING, etc.

UserList.description: A user list (audience or customer match list) in Google Ads.

name.description: Display name of the user list.

membership_life_span.description: Number of days a user remains in the list (1â€“10000).

size_for_display.description: Approximate audience size for Display Network targeting.

size_for_search.description: Approximate audience size for Search targeting.

OfflineConversion.description: An offline conversion event from a click that is uploaded to Google Ads.

conversion_action.description: Resource path of the conversion action to record against.

conversion_date_time.description: Date and time the conversion took place (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS+/-HH:MM).

conversion_value.description: Revenue or monetary value attributed to this conversion.

currency_code.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD.

gclid.description: Google click identifier captured from the originating ad click.

hashed_email.description: SHA-256 hashed and lowercased email address of the converting user.
